RelayIntro: Prepare a Gist node file in Rust, optionally test it, then create or update an independent output Gist. Preview never uploads.
RelayFormatOnly: Formatting only: no node connections or health claims. Untested nodes are retained.
RelayCreateHelp: Leave the output Gist empty to create a new secret Gist with your token. Anyone with its link can read it; it is not encrypted.
RelayCreated: Output Gist created and verified; its target is retained for this session.
RelayFormats: Surge node-only text and node-only sing-box JSON are supported. Sub-Store settings backups and complete routing configurations are not subscriptions.
RelayPrivacy: Private inputs stay in this session, not preferences, history or command arguments. Output stays hidden. Memory erasure is best-effort; focus loss does not cancel an authorized run.
RelayToken: GitHub token (session only; optional for public previews)
RelaySource: Source Gist ID or HTTPS Gist/raw URL
RelaySourceFile: Source filename (may be derived from an explicit raw URL)
RelayOutput: Output Gist ID or HTTPS URL (empty creates a new secret Gist on upload)
RelayEngineHelp: Only connectivity tests use your trusted installed sing-box executable. Formatting needs no engine. System proxy and TUN settings are not changed.
RelayCompatibility: For this run, allow certificate bypass only where the source explicitly requires it (unsafe).
RelayDoh: Use Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 DoH for probes (sends endpoint names; output hostnames are unchanged).
RelayPublishConsent: I authorize this upload to create a secret Gist or replace only the selected output file. Secret Gists are unlisted, not encrypted.
RelayPublicConsent: Allow publishing private node credentials to a PUBLIC Gist (high risk).
RelayPublishWarning: Upload is an explicit network write. Cancellation cannot undo a write already accepted by GitHub. Keep input and output Gists different.
RelayWorking: Private relay running; no task-history record.
RelayWait: Wait for the current operation to finish before starting a relay.
RelayUpload: Uploading selected output and verifying readback
RelayInputInvalid: Enter a valid source Gist and filename, or an explicit raw-file URL.
RelayOutputInvalid: Use a valid output filename and a Gist different from the source, or leave the output Gist empty to create one.
RelayNameInvalid: Output name and filename must each be at most 64 Unicode characters, without control characters.
RelayOptionsInvalid: Use 1–8 parallel checks and a timeout of 1–20 seconds.
RelayTokenInvalid: Enter a valid session token. Upload requires a token; public previews may be anonymous.
RelayConsentRequired: Authorize output creation or replacement before uploading.
RelayConfigInvalid: Check the source, distinct output, name lengths, engine and verification settings.
RelayCancelling: Cancelling. Waiting for the worker and any owned engine; accepted Gist creation receipts are retained.
RelayCancelled: Cancelled. A write already accepted by GitHub may still have completed; inspect any retained output target.
RelayPublished: Output upload read back and verified.
RelayUnchanged: Output is meaningfully unchanged; no upload was needed.
RelayPreviewReady: Preview complete. Nothing was uploaded; plaintext remains hidden.
RelayWorkerStopped: The private relay stopped unexpectedly. No success is claimed; check the output before retrying a possible upload.
RelayNoHealthy: No node has verified success. Existing output was not changed.
RelaySourceChanged: The source changed during checking. Run again before publishing.
RelaySubscriptionInvalid: The selected file is not a valid supported node-only subscription.
RelayDependencyInvalid: Node dependencies are unresolved, ambiguous or cyclic.
RelayRenderFailed: The output could not be prepared safely. Existing output was not changed.
RelayConnectionFailed: GitHub request failed. Check the connection and try again.
RelayHttpStatus: GitHub rejected the request; HTTP status:
RelayResponseInvalid: GitHub returned an invalid or incomplete response.
RelayTooLarge: Gist content exceeds the bounded relay size limit.
RelayFileListIncomplete: The file list is incomplete; the selected file cannot be confirmed absent.
RelayOutputChanged: The output changed during checking. Preview it again before publishing.
RelayPublicOutput: Publishing to a public Gist requires separate confirmation.
RelayWriteUncertain: Creation or update may have been accepted. Inspect your Gists before retrying to avoid duplicates.
RelayReadbackFailed: The output readback did not match. Inspect the output before retrying.
RelayPinnedTarget: Revision-pinned raw URLs are not accepted. Use a Gist ID or a latest-file URL without a revision.
RelayEngineUnavailable: The trusted sing-box executable is unavailable. Check its path.
RelayEngineFailed: The local check engine failed. Engine failure is not dead-node evidence.
RelayUnsupported: The source format or operation cannot be faithfully supported. Existing output was not changed.
VaultIntro: Password-protected configurations. Nothing is fetched automatically.
VaultPrepareHelp: A verified encrypted copy of the originals stays local. A sanitized encrypted template library is prepared for publication. Original files remain untouched.
VaultPrepareSourcesHelp: One local path per line, or drop files here. Existing destinations are never replaced.
VaultManagedStorage: Fixed project storage; valid library locations are remembered automatically.
VaultStorageUnavailable: Project storage is unavailable. The bundled library can still be unlocked; saving requires an available project.
VaultImportEncryptedHint: Drop an encrypted library to import it into fixed local storage after unlocking. The source file is kept.
VaultPasswordHelp: Use a long, unique passphrase. There is no password reset or recovery key.
VaultLockedHelp: Names and configurations stay hidden until unlocked. Public ciphertext can still be attacked offline, so a strong password matters.
VaultSessionHelp: Locks on focus loss or after five idle minutes. Locking discards unsaved changes. Secrets are not saved in preferences or task history; complete memory erasure is not guaranteed.
VaultAutoLocked: Library locked for privacy. Enter the password to continue.
VaultWorking: Processing securely. Locking will discard any late result.
VaultPrepared: Encrypted backup and publication library verified. Original files remain unchanged.
VaultImportHint: Local configuration path, or drop files on this page
VaultImportHelp: Imported contents are stored only in the encrypted library when you save. Original files are not deleted.
VaultImported: Configuration imported. Save the encrypted library to keep it.
VaultEmpty: No configurations yet. Import a local file above.
VaultShadowrocketHelp: Shadowrocket subscriptions are added separately. The configuration export does not embed this URL.
VaultNoFetch: URLs stay in this session and are never requested here.
VaultTemplatePreviewHelp: Template preview only. Subscription fields are applied when you copy or export.
VaultPlaintextConsent: I understand that copying or exporting reveals plaintext.
VaultClipboardWarning: Clipboard history, sync, screenshots and other apps can retain plaintext. Export outside any Git project; do not publish plaintext files.
VaultExportHint: Absolute path outside the project, for example Downloads/profile.conf
VaultOverwrite: Allow replacing an existing destination file
VaultExported: Plaintext configuration exported. Protect the file and do not commit it.
VaultRemoveConfirm: Remove this entry from the library? The original file is not affected. Save to persist this change.
Author: Author
RuleSetPolicyHint: Enter a policy or policy-group name
InvalidRuleSetPolicy: No edge spaces, line breaks, commas, quotes or comment markers; internal spaces are allowed.
InstallHint: Use the copied link in your client to install this item.
SelectItem: Select an item to view its details.
ProgressUnknown: Stage duration varies; see live activity below.
ConfirmWrite: This action will write files to the workspace. Continue?
ConfirmNetwork: This action requires network access. Continue?
SingboxOptional: Optional; only needed for tasks that use sing-box.
LocalOnly: This action stays on this device.
NetworkRequired: Network access is required for this action.
NoAutomaticGit: Git operations are never started automatically.
AboutDescription: A desktop interface for browsing project resources and running explicit workspace tasks.
HelpIntro: Choose a topic below. Templates and subscription relay do not require a workspace.
HelpRelay:
1. Open Subscription relay (Ctrl / Command + 5); no workspace is needed. Use node-only Surge text or sing-box JSON, not a Sub-Store settings backup.
2. Enter its Gist and filename, then preview. Formatting uses Rust alone; enable connectivity tests only if wanted, with a trusted sing-box.
3. Enter a token and authorize upload. Leave the output Gist empty to create a secret Gist, or choose an independent existing target. Secret Gists are link-accessible, not encrypted.
HelpWorkspace: The workspace is the project directory used by local tasks. Check the selected path before running a task.
WorkspaceNotApplied: Load the project folder before running tasks. An unvalidated path will not be saved; appearance settings can still be saved.
ReopenWorkspace: Reopen the saved workspace at startup
OpenWorkspaceHint: Open a workspace to browse resources. Startup does not request folder access automatically.
WorkspacePermissionHelp: The app does not scan folders on startup by default. Opening Desktop, Documents, Downloads or external volumes may require macOS consent. For unattended tasks, use an explicitly selected local workspace outside protected folders. New ad-hoc development builds may require consent again.
HelpUpdates: Updates may write generated files. Review the task and workspace before confirming.
HelpSources: Adding or removing a source saves its configuration locally. Run a full update to rebuild the affected bundle; quick update skips functional bundles. Browsing remains offline.
HelpGit: Repository actions are user-initiated. Review changed files and the selected branch before any write or remote operation.
HelpShortcuts: Search to narrow module and rule lists; select an item for details. Select filtered results adds the current results without clearing earlier selections; clear selection resets them all. Ctrl / Command + 1–5 opens Overview, Library, Tasks, Repository, and Subscription relay. Drag a project folder onto the window to load it.
HelpPrivacy: Workspace files stay local unless you explicitly run an action that uses the network.
SourceTrust: Only add sources you trust; refreshing a source can contact its server.
ConfirmPull: Pull changes from the remote repository?
ConfirmPush: Push commits to the remote repository?
GitSafety: Review the branch, selected files, and remote before continuing.
OverviewDescription: Browse project resources and see the current workspace at a glance.
ShareLogsWarning: Review logs before sharing; they may contain private paths or sensitive data.
TaskIntro: Choose what to maintain. Nothing runs until you start it.
ValidateDescription: Check local rules, modules, references and safety boundaries without changing them.
CatalogDescription: Browse the live local module and rule catalogs; nothing is generated or written.
UpdateDescription: Fetch upstream modules and rules, compile, check and publish the complete local output.
QuickDescription: Update rules without rebuilding functional module bundles.
GamingDescription: Rebuild gaming categories from existing local inputs; this does not fetch upstream changes.
AdBlockDescription: Fetch ad-block sources and rebuild PROMAX, typed rules, mirrors and the catalog.
SrsDescription: Compile current local rules using your sing-box executable. No upstream download.
SingboxRequired: Set a sing-box executable in Settings before running this task.
HistoryIntro: Local task records survive restarts. Unfinished records do not prove that a worker has stopped.
RecordHistoryHelp: Keep up to 100 local task summaries, without workspace paths or diagnostic logs by default.
DeveloperModeHelp: Show diagnostic options. Safety validation and write confirmations stay enabled.
DiagnosticLogsHelp: Opt-in only. Excerpts are bounded and common credentials are redacted, but review before sharing: logs may contain private data.
ConfirmClearHistory: Delete saved finished task records and their log excerpts? This cannot be undone; unfinished records are kept.
ConfirmRemoveUnfinishedHistory: Remove all unfinished task-history records? This cannot be undone. Use this only after checking that no other Script Hub window is running a task; records for active tasks in other instances will also be removed.
NoSavedLogs: No diagnostic logs were retained for this task.
DependencyLicenseHelp: Verbatim notices are bundled for offline use, including font and SQLite notices. Copy the full text to inspect it in your preferred reader.
LicenseScope: Project-authored code follows the repository's GPLv3 license. Third-party rules, scripts and libraries retain their own licenses; this is not a claim that every source is cleared for redistribution.
SourceValidationHint: Public GitHub Raw or jsDelivr module URL only; HTTPS, no credentials, query or fragment.
